name: Reserve
author: ReidenXerx
description: The battery screen your phone has, for your laptop: the day's level with charging and sleep marked, how much battery each app used, how long what is left will last, the battery's health over months, and a plain-words reason when it drained faster than it should. Never wakes the NVIDIA GPU to measure it; no root, no network.

barWidget.description: Battery usage by app, health and charging, the way a phone shows them
